retention.stated: 沙箱控制器负责管理 Pod 的整个生命周期，包括创建、定时删除、暂停以及恢复操作; VCI 不会自动清理镜像仓库的镜像。
retention.notes: Scheduled deletion is configurable and the page states no default retention period; sandbox disk snapshots are stored on EBS.

egress.terms: 公网 IP is listed as a separately billed IaaS resource in the VCI pay-as-you-go pricing page ('公网 IP | 用于实现相关资源与公网通信。'), and the feature page states sandbox network access is controllable. No included free traffic volume or per-GB rate is published for VCI Agent Sandbox itself.

record.interface_detail: The sandbox is exposed as a Kubernetes Agent Sandbox CRD and supports the E2B protocol: 'VCI Agent Sandbox CRD ... 创建、定时删除、暂停、恢复' and 'E2B 协议（Agent Execution Protocol）是一套基于 Protobuf + HTTP/2 + Server\-Sent Events（SSE）的标准化通信协议'. Neither maps cleanly to the closed interface vocabulary; REST/gRPC-style HTTP/2 control-plane calls are used.
record.endpoint: https://api.watasu.io/v1/sandboxes is NOT this provider; VCI is reached through the VKE Kubernetes API and the E2B control plane; no public endpoint is published
record.tooling: A VKE cluster with the VCI Agent Sandbox controller, SandboxTemplate/SandboxClaim/SandboxWarmPool CRDs and kubectl; SDKs built on the E2B protocol are documented.
record.chaining: An agent uses the Sandbox CRD or E2B protocol to run code in a Kata-isolated MicroVM and writes results to EBS snapshots or a separately billed object store, while public egress runs over separately billed public IP or NAT gateway resources.

identity_cost.detail: Registration requires '+86 手机号' (a mainland-China mobile number) and, before buying or using cloud products, 实名认证: an individual must supply 姓名 and 身份证号码 and pass face verification or supply a bank card and its reserved mobile number; overseas phone numbers are not supported. Account balance above CNY 100 is required when creating certain VKE resources.

record.reliability_note: Billing is per second and settled hourly; snapshots must be finished before restore and image repositories are not cleaned up automatically, so image layers and stored snapshots accumulate until manually managed. One Pod replica and one container per sandbox.
